channel.description: The latest quotes about Andris Biedrins from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Bill Duffy on Andris Biedrins
item.description:
Andris Biedrins' agent said Saturday that reports on the Warriors' center signing with different European teams were erroneous, but that Biedrins will explore overseas options next month.

“I think (Biedrins) would be open to playing overseas on a temporary or a long-term basis if the (NBA) lockout continues, but we've got to get him some insurance to protect his (NBA) contract,”

Bill Duffy on Andris Biedrins, Aug 21, 2011. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.

item.title: Bill Duffy on Andris Biedrins
item.description:
Marc Stein:Agent Bill Duffy:

“We are not closing door on Andris playing in Europe. (But) reports of him signing in Latvia and Turkey are erroneous.”

Bill Duffy on Andris Biedrins, Aug 20, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Bill Duffy on Andris Biedrins
item.description:
Marc Stein:More from agent Bill Duffy on Warriors' Biedrins:

“We will likely visit the prospects of him signing in Europe in September.”

Bill Duffy on Andris Biedrins, Aug 20, 2011. Source: Twitter.
